ns2:course.label: Evolution Air & Space Power I
ns2:course.description: "The Evolution of USAF Air and Space Power" features topics on Air Force heritage and leaders; introduction to air power through examination of the Air Force Core Functions; and continued application of communication skills. Its purpose is to instill an appreciation of the development and employment of air power and to motivate sophomore students to transition from AFROTC cadet to Air Force ROTC officer candidate. Prerequisite: AFAS 112 or consent of instructor. Requires concurrent enrollment with AFAS 102.
